note: Adapted from the species-level description no. 273 in Chhotani (1997), The Fauna of India: Isoptera. Original in English; only the soldier and worker are known, the alate is recorded as unknown in the original, and nymphs are lacking; synonymic lists (including that of Microtermes incertus), bibliographic citations, figure numbers and distribution records are omitted.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head capsule oval, slightly longer than wide, sides narrowed anteriorly; antennae 14-segmented, 2nd segment nearly equal to the 3rd and 4th combined; labrum spear-shaped, extending to two-thirds of the mandibles, apex narrow and pointed; mandibles thin and slender, slightly incurved anteriorly; postmentum slightly longer than wide, sides slightly convex; pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior margin notched, posterior margin broadly incurved at the middle.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule straw yellow; labrum pale yellow; antennae and body whitish; mandibles reddish brown, paler at the base. Head and body rather densely pilose. Body length 3.30–4.0 mm. Head capsule oval, slightly longer than wide (to mandible base 0.80–0.88 mm, maximum width 0.75–0.78 mm); sides narrowed anteriorly. Antennae 14-segmented; 2nd segment nearly equal to the 3rd and 4th combined. Labrum spear-shaped, extending to two-thirds of the mandibles; apex narrow and pointed (length 0.30–0.33 mm, width 0.20–0.23 mm). Mandibles thin and slender, slightly incurved anteriorly (length 0.50–0.53 mm, mandible length/head length ratio 0.60–0.63). Postmentum slightly longer than wide; sides slightly convex (length 0.45 mm, width 0.35–0.38 mm). Pronotum saddle-shaped; anterior margin notched, posterior margin broadly incurved at the middle (length 0.35 mm, width 0.48–0.53 mm).

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Dimorphic. Major worker: head capsule pale yellowish brown; labrum and postclypeus pale yellow; antennae and body milk white. Head and body moderately pilose. Body length 3.5–4.30 mm. Head subsquare, sides slightly convergent posteriorly (to mandible base 0.80 mm, width 0.87 mm). Antennae 14-segmented. Postclypeus convex, half as long as wide. Pronotum saddle-shaped (maximum width 0.46 mm); anterior margin deeply concave, posterior margin nearly straight. Minor worker: as the major worker, head capsule subcircular; body length about 3.0 mm, head width 0.68 mm, pronotum width 0.42 mm.
